a: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
p: Rabbi-jʿalnī muqīma-ṣ-ṣalāti wa min dhurriyyatī, rabbanā wa taqabbal duʿā'.
m: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
